name: Krezk and the Abbey of St. Markovia

places.name: Krezk
places.summary: The walled village at the western end of the valley, where the road stops. Its gate opens only for a reason.

places.name: The Abbey of St. Markovia
places.when: visited:krezk or tarokka.ally.npc == ezmerelda or tarokka.tome.region == abbey_of_st_markovia or tarokka.symbol.region == abbey_of_st_markovia or tarokka.sword.region == abbey_of_st_markovia
places.summary: A stone abbey on the mountainside above Krezk, built by a saint for the sick and the motherless, kept now by the Abbot.

places.name: The Waystone
places.summary: A bend of the Old Svalich Road on the way to Krezk, where an old sunburst waystone stands with a candle at its foot that somebody lights every night.
